description.value: BarBurrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, proudly Canadian since 2005, with over 385 locations nationwide. This Kelowna outlet sits inside Capri Centre mall and serves fully customizable Mexican-inspired burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas built from fresh, in-house ingredients. A touring cyclist can quickly assemble a filling, high-calorie meal with a wide range of proteins and dietary options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website location page confirms the address (1729 Gordon Dr., Kelowna, BC V1Y 3H3) and provides a phone number not present in OSM ((250) 717-0959). OSM takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's online ordering and delivery partner links. The nutrition calculator subpage explicitly lists a 'Gluten Free' tortilla option and 'Veggie' and 'Falafel' protein options, confirming vegetarian/GF availability; no evidence was found for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; (250) 717-0959 sourced from the website location page and added to this listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant in an active mall location; website is current and confirms operating hours.
